title: Heidi Klum Deserves a Hand for Halloween Costume's Hidden Nod to Husband Tom Kaulitz
text:
Heidi Klum Halloween 2026 Costume Explained: Her Hand & Tom Kaulitz Tattoo 
 E!'s The Golden Life
 Watch Episode 2 Now! News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Exclusive Heidi Klum Deserves a Hand for Halloween Costume's Hidden Nod to Husband Tom Kaulitz
 Heidi Klum exclusively shared with E! News how much work went into her costume for her 25th annual Halloween Party—and why she chose to dress as a severed body part.
 By Lindsay Weinberg , Sabba Rahbar Nov 01, 2026 3:00 AM | Updated 25 minutes ago Tags Fashion Red Carpet Heidi Klum Interviews Exclusives Halloween Celebrities Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Heidi Klum Shares Glimpse of Grotesque 2026 Halloween Costume One Week Before Annual Bash You've got to hand it to Heidi Klum —she really is  the Queen of Halloween .  
 The Project Runway star unveiled her spook-tacular costume at her 25th Annual Halloween Party at Cathédrale Restaurant in New York Oct. 31,  transforming into a bloody severed hand. And she revealed just how much work went into her epic look. 
 "Literally, my left hand inspired me," Klum exclusively told E! News on the red carpet. "I looked at my hand and I was thinking, 'How can I fit my body into this hand?' There must be a way... Two legs could fit into fingers and the body in my palm, and it did work."
 It took her six hours to get ready on Oct. 31, but her team has been working for months to create the prosthetics—or, as she quipped, "Many hands doing this hand."
 And it's not just any old hand, but a replica of her real left hand—down to the green stone wedding ring and finger tattoo reading "Tom" in honor of husband Tom Kaulitz . As Klum noted, "I got it on our wedding day."
 read Heidi Klum and Daughter Lou, 16, Are the Ultimate Duo at Paris Fashion Week As for the significance of the red nail polish?
 "I do like red nails," she explained, "but also for the photo afterwards—I think a red nail just pops, you know, on the red carpet."
 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum The 53-year-old had teased the look just one week earlier , posting a glimpse of her smashing costume on Instagram Oct. 24. 
 Klum—mom to kids Leni , 22, with ex Flavio Briatore , as well as Henry , 21, Johan , 19, and Lou , 16, with ex Seal —showed a close-up of the prosthetic-heavy outfit with colorful shapes and textures, including several parts that appeared to look like human organs. 
 Noam Galai/Getty Images for Heidi Klum Of course, the model is no stranger to focusing on her fa-boo-lous look all year long, revealing to E! News that her Medusa costume from last year was one she’d been thinking about “for quite some time” and took a full five months to put together.  
 "Everything is hand-painted," she shared. "About 15 people have been working on this, and I think they did a fantastic job." 
 “I’ve seen over the years obviously many, many Medusas, and I thought, ‘You know, one day I'm going to try my own,’” she continued. “I really wanted to have snakes that were moving, a super-ugly, super-scary face, really ugly teeth, and to be like a really long rattlesnake." 
 Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic Since moving to America from Germany , Klum has made it her mission to not only go all out for Halloween, but to also give others a place to have a gourd time. 
 “And it's worked,” she told The Hollywood Reporter in 2018, “because, over the years, people have become increasingly more outrageous with their costumes. The party has become almost legendary. It's epic. I feel like my love for Halloween has made other people fall in love with the holiday, too." 
 For a look at all their stars strutting their eerie-sistible costumes at Klum’s 2026 Halloween party, keep reading.  
 —Reporting by Nikaline McCarley
